description: The pie chart presents the distribution of a total quantity across two categories, showing how the whole is divided between “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” There are 2 slices: “Reduction” is colored orange and labeled as 60.9s (69.92%), and “Efficient deployment” is colored blue and labeled as 26.2s (30.08%). Percentage and value labels are printed inside the slices, and the category names appear outside near their respective segments. No separate legend is shown, and neither slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the two segments are arranged with the larger orange slice occupying most of the circle and the smaller blue slice occupying the remaining portion.
